theorems.name: Submission.isoperimetric_coord_box_measure
theorems.statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (α : SimonMultiIndex n N) (c : Fin N → ℝ) (a b : ℝ), a ≤ b → (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl N)) {x : Eucl N | ∀ i : Fin N, (i ∈ range α → c i + a ≤ x i ∧ x i ≤ c i + b) ∧ (i ∉ range α → x i = c i)} = ENNReal.ofReal ((b - a) ^ n)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
